evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Tube pressure was 2.952 Torr at the start of growth.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.159 Torr despite nominally constant temperature and argon flow; cause and acceptable pressure range are not established.
Temperature 750.2 °C and argon flow 100.3 sccm track setpoints; O2 remains unavailable, so these readings cannot establish atmosphere compliance.

args.missing_evidence: Required exhaust O2 measurement, growth pressure acceptance limits or normal-run reference, and a pressure/atmosphere diagnostic to distinguish leakage, exhaust restriction, and benign drift; sample characterization is also not yet available.
